m.helpText: Announce your last season 2040/41 is the proposed final year. Announcing a farewell commits you to one final year. There is no undo button for the announcement. This year has already started. Confirming resumes that same year, without ageing you again. You see the actual season results and any queued award, international or rivalry ceremonies, then retire before another transfer window or year. Injuries, bans and the existing forced retirement rules still apply. A farewell does not guarantee appearances, fitness or silverware. Example: announce 2040/41. Even if you have a great year, your career ends after its results and queued ceremonies. Back ? Review announcement Close

steps.name: brief rules after a broken promise

m.helpText: Your transfer brief What matters most in your next move? Pick a priority, save the brief, then use Request transfer in the window. Saving a brief does not request a move. Your club broke its appearance promise, so this request gets a response for sure. Your agent searches clubs already eligible for your age and rating in this save's next season. Minutes uses the same league appearance bands as the season engine. Club level uses the game's tiers, with tier 1 the highest. Home uses your nationality country. Example: two eligible clubs project 8 to 16 and 20 to 30 league games. Minutes targets the second club. Injuries and selection can still change your season. No matching clubs means no offer. A saved response cannot be rolled again by reloading. Club-arranged sales and loans still follow the club's decision. Back to brief ? Choose a priority Close
